security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, when V=1 and hgatp.MODE=Bare, the SPMP checker generates VS/VU access violations but the exception generation logic in the CSR module incorrectly raises supervisor page fault exception codes (12/13/15) instead of guest page fault codes (20/21/23). This occurs when the hardware fails to conditionally select the exception code based on the (virtualization_active AND hgatp_mode_bare) predicate, routing hSPMP violations to VS-mode trap handlers instead of HS-mode.
security_spec.summary: PR #75 merges hSPMP into baseline SPMP: when V=1 and hgatp.MODE=Bare, SPMP violations on VS/VU accesses must raise guest page fault codes (20/21/23) not supervisor page fault codes (12/13/15); incorrect exception code routing in hardware would deliver hSPMP violations to the guest OS instead of the hypervisor, allowing a malicious guest to handle its own SPMP faults and bypass hypervisor-enforced memory protections
